c74object.name: el.mask~
c74object.digest: Impulse-driven pattern generator and rhythmic mask
c74object.description:
el.mask~ is an impulse-driven pattern sequencer and rhythmic mask. In response to incoming non-zero audio clicks or impulses, it steps through a stored sequence of floating-point values and emits the next value as a single-sample impulse. It can store up to 1024 unique patterns (up to 512 values each) in memory, cycle through patterns in automated sequences (sequence), preserve phase alignment across pattern changes (phaselock), or use incoming click values as direct lookup indices (indexmode).
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Trigger impulses and control message inlet. Receives non-zero audio clicks to advance the pattern, as well as pattern definition and sequencing commands (addmask, recall, sequence, etc.).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Masked impulse output. Emits single-sample impulses with amplitudes corresponding to values in the active mask pattern on trigger samples, and 0.0 at all other times.

inlet.description: Receives non-zero audio samples to trigger and advance mask patterns, as well as configuration and sequencing commands.

outlet.description: Outputs an impulse corresponding to the active pattern value when triggered, and 0.0 otherwise.

objarg.name: initial-pattern
objarg.description: Initial sequence of numeric values stored directly into pattern slot 0 (up to 512 values).

method.name: addmask
method.description: Stores a pattern into memory. The first argument specifies the storage slot index (0 to 1023), followed by a list of pattern values (up to 512 values).

method.name: gate
method.description: When set to 1 (default), pattern values are emitted on incoming clicks. When set to 0, the pattern playhead continues to advance with incoming clicks, but the output remains silent (0.0).

method.name: gozero
method.description: Resets the active pattern playhead back to index 0 on the next incoming trigger click.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal pattern output resumes.

method.name: noloop
method.description: When set to 1, the object automatically mutes itself when the active pattern reaches its end. When set to 0 (default), patterns loop continuously.

method.name: phaselock
method.digest: Lock playhead phase on pattern change
method.description: When set to 1, the current playhead position is preserved when switching patterns via recall or sequence. When set to 0 (default), switching patterns resets the playhead to index 0.

method.name: playonce
method.description: Selects pattern slot-index, resets its playhead to 0, unmutes the object, and automatically mutes it when the pattern reaches its end.

method.name: recall
method.description: Switches playback to the pattern stored in memory slot slot-index (0 to 1023).

method.name: sequence
method.description: Initiates automated sequence cycling through the provided list of pattern slot indices. Each pattern plays through once before advancing to the next slot in the sequence list.

method.name: showmask
method.description: Prints the pattern length and index values stored in slot slot-index to the Max Console.

method.name: signal
method.description: Incoming trigger impulses. Any non-zero sample triggers the next pattern value.

attribute.name: indexmode
attribute.description: When set to 1 (On), incoming non-zero click amplitudes are treated as 1-based indices to address values directly in the active pattern (modulo pattern length), rather than stepping linearly. When set to 0 (Off, default), clicks advance the pattern sequentially.
